tasks.short: Recommend chemical or biological wastewater treatment methods.

steps.what: Analyze current wastewater treatment results against the permit.
Compare chemical and biological treatment methods on dose.

loop.output: Comparison rows: method, dose, sludge and stated limit
loop.check: Engineer checks each dose against the source note
loop.stop: One pass; a dose without a source is left blank
loop.why_not_simpler: Method notes mix prose and tables, so one grid misses the dose

steps.what: Judge which treatment method the plant can actually run.
Talk through chemical handling on the treatment plant.
Supplier states dose ranges for the shortlisted methods.
Recommend the wastewater treatment method in a signed note.

loop.input: Judgement, operator notes and supplier dose
loop.output: Recommendation naming the method, the dose and the open risk
loop.check: Engineer edits every dose before the note is sent
loop.stop: One draft; a dose that was not confirmed is removed
loop.why_not_simpler: The note must follow the judgement, not a generic method list

tasks.design: Permit results already in the {OPS_SYSTEM} are lined up in {SPREADSHEET}. Dose tables are read from the method notes, and the engineer still judges what the plant can run, including the talk on site. The recommendation is sent only after that judgement is checked.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each method comparison started by retyping permit results and doses into a fresh sheet.
tasks.enabler_now: Results and dose rows can be compared before the meeting. The choice of method stays.
tasks.still_hard: Seeing that a method meets the permit on paper and still fails in this plant's hands.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer knows the operator's real chemical handling, which the dose table does not.

ambition.what: Drop a chemical method that misses a sludge or toxicity limit before the recommendation meeting.

tasks.altitude: Method talks stay. The engineer can refuse a note whose dose is not on the comparison.

reach.task: Study chemical handling time on the treatment shift
reach.learn: Which method adds lifts or protective steps the dose table ignores

evidence.claim: A numeric limit or quantity can be calculated; the engineer still judges the exception.
The signing engineer stays responsible for what is issued.
Safety components in water supply are treated as high-risk under the EU AI Act.

assumptions: Focal role is the water engineer. Boundary: from current results and method notes to a signed method recommendation. Detailed unit design is out of scope.
Test native {SPREADSHEET} tables before custom code.
Structured fields are method, dose, sludge yield, toxicity limit and permit parameter. Suppliers produce dose notes. Fallback: a blank dose stays open and cannot be recommended.
The site talk about handling is not a document review.
unknowns: Which toxicity limits are numeric in the permit.
Whether operators may trial a dose without a change note.
research_questions: Which methods have no full-scale reference on wastewater like this plant's?

already_counted.description: Judging methods the dose table cannot separate

incremental.description: Refresh sludge and toxicity limits when the permit changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A plant with numeric permit history saves the results pass and the dose extract. The judgement, the operator talk and odd wastes stay. The low case is a method with no dose source.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Identify design alternatives for new water resources.

steps.what: List design alternatives already studied for water resources.

loop.input: Earlier resource studies and the constraint map
loop.output: Alternative list: source, yield, constraint and study reference
loop.check: Engineer checks each yield against the study
loop.stop: One pass; a yield without a study reference is blank
loop.why_not_simpler: Old studies do not share a table of alternatives

steps.what: Score water resource alternatives on yield and cost.
Judge which design alternatives are worth developing.
Discuss the alternatives with the client.
Record the water resources alternative that was chosen.

loop.output: Record of the chosen source, yield and rejected options
loop.check: Engineer checks the chosen yield against the score sheet
loop.stop: One draft; an option the client did not discuss is removed
loop.why_not_simpler: The record must match the meeting, not the highest score alone

tasks.design: Earlier studies are read into an alternative list in {DOCS}, and yield and cost are scored in {SPREADSHEET}. The engineer still judges which alternative can be developed and discusses it with the client. The chosen record is filed only after that check.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each new resource question started from unread old studies and a blank comparison.
tasks.enabler_now: Yield and cost can be scored once the alternatives are listed. Choosing among them stays.
tasks.still_hard: Judging a cheaper source that fails in a dry year the score treats as average.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer weighs a constraint the old study stated and the client still disputes.

ambition.what: Put a reuse alternative beside a new abstraction on every resource question, not only when a reservoir is proposed.

tasks.altitude: The client discussion stays. The engineer can refuse to record a choice that has no yield source.

reach.task: Screen a reservoir or intake site for construction constraints
reach.learn: Which ground constraints make a high-yield alternative undevelopable

evidence.claim: A numeric limit or quantity can be calculated; the engineer still judges the exception.
The signing engineer stays responsible for what is issued.

assumptions: Focal role is the water engineer. Boundary: from existing studies to a recorded alternative. Detailed design of the chosen source is out of scope.
Test {DOCS} fields and {SPREADSHEET} scores before custom code.
Structured fields are source name, yield, cost band, constraint and study reference. Past studies produce them. Fallback: the engineer types a blank yield and that alternative cannot be chosen.
The client discussion is not replaced by the score.
unknowns: Whether reuse is in the client's brief or must be added.
Which old studies are still valid.
research_questions: Which constraints are legal bars rather than costs?

already_counted.description: Judging alternatives the score cannot separate
Checking the recorded choice against the meeting

incremental.description: Keep the alternative fields aligned when a study is superseded

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A question with readable past studies saves the list and the score. The judgement and the client talk stay. The low case is a source with no yield study.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design runoff collection networks and water supply channels.

steps.what: Gather runoff catchment data for the collection networks.

loop.input: Catchment map notes and the rainfall table
loop.output: Catchment sheet: area, runoff coefficient and storm depth
loop.check: Engineer checks each area against the map
loop.stop: One pass; an area without a map reference is blank
loop.why_not_simpler: Catchments are drawn, not stored as one table

steps.what: Calculate peak runoff for each collection reach.
Size water supply channels and the culverts.
Lay the runoff collection networks on the ground model.
Walk the supply channels and check each crossing.
Drafter draws the channel and network sheets.
Issue the runoff collection design for review.

loop.input: Runoff sheet, sizes and crossing notes
loop.output: Issue note with storm case, sizes and open crossings
loop.check: Engineer checks every size against the sheet
loop.stop: One draft; a size not on the sheet is removed
loop.why_not_simpler: The issue must name the storm that was calculated

tasks.design: Catchment fields drive peak runoff and channel size in {SPREADSHEET}. The engineer still lays the collection network on the ground model and walks the crossings. The issue leaves only after sizes are checked against that storm.
tasks.previous_blocker: Rainfall and areas were retyped, and crossings were found after the first drawing.
tasks.enabler_now: Peak flow and a channel size follow once area and storm depth are fields. The route stays a layout.
tasks.still_hard: A crossing that the peak flow fits and the ground will not.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer has walked the route and will not issue a channel the bank cannot hold.

ambition.what: Size every reach for the stated storm before the channel is drawn, including reaches that used to be copied from the last job.

tasks.altitude: Route walks stay. The engineer can hold an issue with a blank area or an unchecked crossing.

reach.task: Set the opening a road crossing must keep clear
reach.learn: Which crossings have a road level the channel cannot ignore

evidence.claim: A numeric limit or quantity can be calculated; the engineer still judges the exception.
The signing engineer stays responsible for what is issued.
Laying a channel on a ground model is design work, not a summary of the runoff table.

assumptions: Focal role is the water engineer. Boundary: from catchment data to the issued collection design. Bridge structural design is out of scope.
Test native {SPREADSHEET} formulas before custom code.
Structured fields are area, coefficient, storm depth, peak flow, channel width and slope. The catchment map produces areas. Fallback: a blank area blocks sizing for that reach.
Walking crossings is a site check.
unknowns: Which storm depth the client is obliged to use.
Whether the ground model and the survey are the same date.
research_questions: Which reaches need a backwater check the peak formula does not give?

already_counted.description: Checking issued sizes against the runoff sheet
Laying out reaches the formula does not place

incremental.description: Keep storm depths and coefficients aligned with the agreed standard
Drafter time after a route change

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A mapped catchment saves the extract and the peak-flow pass. Layout, the walk and odd crossings stay. The low case is a catchment with no agreed storm.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design wastewater lift stations and water wells.

steps.what: Driller reports yield for the water wells.
Set duty and flood level for the lift stations.
Calculate lift head for the wells and the station.
Lay out wastewater lift stations and the wellhead.
Check the wells and the discharge point on site.
Issue the lift stations design for review.

loop.input: Lift sheet, layout list and site notes
loop.output: Issue note with duty, head, flood level and layout version
loop.check: Engineer checks head and flood level against the sheet
loop.stop: One draft; a head not on the sheet is removed
loop.why_not_simpler: The issue must show this well's yield, not a generic station

tasks.design: Well yield arrives as a record. Lift head is calculated in {SPREADSHEET} after the engineer sets duty and flood level. The wellhead layout and the site check stay. The design is issued only when head and flood level match that version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Yield, flood level and head were copied by hand into a station workbook.
tasks.enabler_now: Head follows from duty, yield and level. Setting the flood duty and drawing the wellhead stay.
tasks.still_hard: A yield the driller reports and a flood level that puts the wellhead under water.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer will not set a pump that the site shows cannot be reached or powered.

ambition.what: Compare the wellhead level with the flood level before the station is drawn, on every well, not only after a flood comment.

tasks.altitude: Station layout stays. The engineer can hold an issue when yield or flood level is blank.

reach.task: Size the supply and the control panel for a lift station
reach.learn: Which pump duties the electrical supply cannot start

evidence.claim: A numeric limit or quantity can be calculated; the engineer still judges the exception.
The signing engineer stays responsible for what is issued.
Safety components in water supply are treated as high-risk under the EU AI Act.

assumptions: Focal role is the water engineer. Boundary: from well yield and flood level to the issued lift-station design. Sewer network design is out of scope.
Test native {SPREADSHEET} formulas before custom code.
Structured fields are yield, depth, duty flow, static head, flood level and pump setting. The driller produces yield. Fallback: a missing yield blocks the pump setting.
The site check is not a calculation.
unknowns: Whether flood level is a mapped level or a local memory.
research_questions: Which wells need a drawdown test the driller's first yield does not replace?

already_counted.description: Setting duty when yield and flood level conflict
Checking the issued head and flood level

incremental.description: Keep fitting losses and flood freeboard rules current

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A well with a clear yield saves the head calculation. Duty, layout and the site check stay. The low case is a flood level nobody has surveyed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Method recommendations, resource choices, channel routes and lift stations stay engineer work. Retyping of doses, yields and storm areas shrinks.
skills_to_grow: Holding a recommendation when a dose or a yield is blank
Comparing flood level with the wellhead before drawing
Scoring a reuse option beside a new abstraction
role.ambitious_version: The engineer can stop a method, a channel size or a wellhead that fails its numeric check before the drawing or the meeting.
